gradeResult.summary: Regression is fixed: matchBefore uses /[\w$]+/ (with +), so word.from points at the start of the full identifier and accepting ReadableStream replaces the typed prefix instead of inserting at the last char. All five rubric dimensions hold — module-level cache guarded by `if (options === null)`, validFor /^[\w$]*$/ with from=word.from, explicit aborted + null-word handling, the same three-entry editorCompletionSources wiring, and the cached list is just result.options from scopeCompletionSource(globalThis) so candidate coverage is unchanged. The only call site of scopeCompletionSource(globalThis) outside the bare-identifier guard is the deliberate property-access delegation required by the regression-fix spec.

dimensions.justification: Module-level cachedGlobalScopeOptions assigned once inside `if (options === null)` guard; the second call site is the property-access delegation, not the bare-identifier hot path.
matchBefore(/[\w$]+/) uses `+` (the fix), and the returned result uses from=word.from with validFor /^[\w$]*$/.
Explicit `if (context.aborted) return null` precedes everything; null-word + !context.explicit returns null.

Same three-entry editorCompletionSources shape: cachedScopeCompletion replaces the old scope source at index 0, sandboxServiceCompletions at index 1, builtInTsCompletion appended in TS mode at index 2; no extra autocompletion(...) extension added.
Cached list stores result.options from scopeCompletionSource(globalThis) verbatim; property-access paths return the source's result verbatim, preserving console.l behavior.

notes: attempt 1 graded pass on the rubric but user reported a regression after merge: matchBefore(/[\w$]/) matched a single char so CompletionResult.from pointed at the last identifier char, leaving the document as ReadabReadableStream on accept and triggering the builtInTsCompletion usage-template popover.

attempt 2: regex changed to /[\w$]+/ so word.from = start of full identifier; property-access paths (word.text contains '.') now delegate to the underlying scope source so console.l keeps returning console's properties. All 5 rubric dimensions still pass.
